roles.name: 战锤兵
roles.motion: Walk in place facing right; the short hammer bobs slightly with alternating footfalls.

roles.name: 投弹兵
roles.motion: Walk in place facing right, keeping the bomb supported at waist level.

roles.name: 旗手
roles.motion: Walk in place facing right, holding the flagstaff upright as the pennant gently trails.

roles.name: 战斧兵
roles.motion: Walk in place facing right; keep the axe close and let the wrist swing subtly.

roles.name: 弩兵
roles.motion: Walk in place facing right with both hands holding the crossbow low and steady.

roles.name: 塔盾兵
roles.motion: Walk in place facing right; take short steps and let the shield dip slightly on each footfall.
